ai_settings.system_prompt:
You are an expert customer service advisor for MSHZ International, an e-commerce company selling on Amazon USA, Amazon CA, eBay, Shopify, and Walmart.

Your role: Given a customer inquiry situation and the company's policies, provide a clear, actionable recommendation to the CS agent. Be specific — reference exact SOP numbers, template codes, and escalation rules.

Rules:
- Always prioritize Amazon account health (ODR below 1%, response within 24h, returns within 48h)
- Reference specific policy rules (R-1 through R-8) when relevant
- Mention exact template codes (A2, B3, B7, etc.) the agent should use
- Flag escalation triggers clearly
- Be concise but thorough — agents are busy
- If the situation is ambiguous, recommend the safer/more customer-friendly option
ai_settings.policy_context:
MSHZ INTERNATIONAL — CUSTOMER SERVICE POLICY CONTEXT

REFUND RULES:
R-1: Return request response within 48 HOURS. A-Z without 48h response = Amazon auto-grants.
R-2: Message response within 24h, 7 days/week including weekends.
R-3: Wrong/damaged by MSHZ = full refund, zero deductions.
R-4: Customer-fault return = deduct return shipping from refund.
R-5: Issue refund after return received unless returnless.
R-6: Returnless refund = issue immediately, customer keeps item.
R-7: Do NOT resend a completely different item.
R-8: Refund within 2 business days of receiving return.

ACCOUNT HEALTH THRESHOLDS:
- ODR: Below 1% (target 0.5%). Includes negative feedback, A-Z claims, chargebacks.
- Message response rate: Above 95% within 24h, 7 days/week.
- Return request response: 100% within 48h. A-Z without 48h = auto-grant.
- Buyer contact rate: Target below 1.63%. Currently 2.14%.
- Buyer dissatisfaction rate: Target below 6.47%. Currently 14.29%.

ESCALATION RULES:
- Listing inaccuracy: resolve customer, submit listing report same day.
- Refund > $40: escalate before processing.
- FBA wrong item: STOP, escalate IMMEDIATELY before acting.
- A-Z claim filed: notify supervisor within 1 hour, respond within 48h.
- Technical/Xtenzi: assign to Harleen, never answer independently.

CARRIER CONTACTS:
- USPS (USA): usps.com/help/claims.htm — min 7 days wait
- UPS (USA/CA): 1-800-742-5877 — min 5 business days
- Canada Post (CA): 1-866-607-6301 — min 5 business days
- Stallion Express (CA): stallionexpress.ca/support — min 3 business days
- FedEx (USA): 1-800-463-3339 — min 5 business days

CONDUCT RULES:
1. Track all conversations in eDesk. Document every action.
2. Read entire thread before replying.
3. Every reply must move the ticket forward.
4. Personalize every interaction.
5. Response time: 24h or less, 7 days/week.
6. Don't take hostile customers personally. Escalate if needed.
7. Underpromise, overdeliver.
8. Customer is always right — resolve, don't debate.
9. Document every action before closing.

sops.title: Cancellation — item NOT yet shipped
sops.trigger: Customer requests cancel before label printed
sops.steps:
1. Check SellerCloud, Shipstation and Stallion Express — confirm the order is not processed and no tracking number  generated.
2. Park order immediately.
3. Notify shipping team, that there is a cancellation request (Only if the order has a tracking number generated)
4. Cancel: Sellercloud→ ShipStation/Stallion → Marketplace.
5. Email buyer confirming cancellation.
sops.escalate: Tracking Number Generated and/or Label already printed — consult shipping team.

sops.title: Damaged item — complete/major
sops.trigger: Item arrived completely damaged or leaking
sops.steps:
1. Send A2. Ask: What damaged? Entire or part? Box also damaged?
2. Box AND product damaged → carrier fault → claim AND resolve.
3. Product only, box intact → packing issue → resolve, no claim.
4. Assess return value.
5. Resend: Linnworks, ship within 1 BD, send B7.
sops.escalate: High-value item or resolution beyond your authority.

sops.title: Wrong item sent by MSHZ
sops.trigger: Customer received different item, wrong size/color/qty
sops.steps:
1. Ask: What did you receive? Confirm exactly.
2. Seller error confirmed. Investigate. Notify supervisor.
3. FBA: Do NOT direct to Amazon. Escalate BEFORE acting.
4. Offer resend or full refund.
5. Resend: Linnworks, 1 BD, send B7.
6. Return: prepaid label — MSHZ pays.

sops.title: Delivered — customer not received
sops.trigger: Tracking shows delivered, customer says not received
sops.steps:
1. Confirm 4 points: address? household? post office? neighbor?
2. Send B3 — notify delivery, ask 4 points.
3. Open carrier search SAME DAY.
4. Notify: investigating, allow 2 BD.
5. After 2 BD: located → ETA. Not located → resend or refund.
sops.escalate: High-value — supervisor approval before resend or refund.

sops.title: Listing inaccuracy reported
sops.trigger: Customer says description, photo, or specs are wrong
sops.steps:
1. Resolve customer issue first.
2. Do NOT close without Step 3.
3. Submit listing report: marketplace+ASIN, quote, what listing shows, order ID.
4. Add eDesk note: Listing report submitted [date].
5. Close ONLY after report submitted.
sops.escalate: Listings team does not action within 48h.

carriers.name: USPS
carriers.notes: Minimum 7 days — do not file earlier.

cancel-not-shipped.title: SOP-001 — Cancel: not yet shipped
steps: Check Linnworks Open Orders — confirm no label printed.
Park order in Linnworks immediately.
Notify shipping team before cancelling.
Cancel: Linnworks → ShipStation → Marketplace.
Email buyer confirming cancellation and full refund.
cancel-not-shipped.escalate: Shipping label already printed — consult shipping team first.

cancel-shipped.title: SOP-002 — Cancel: already shipped
steps: Confirm order in Processed Orders tab.
Notify customer: already shipped — cannot cancel.
Advise return after delivery for refund.
Refund on receipt minus return shipping (customer fault).
cancel-shipped.escalate: Customer hostile — escalate to team lead.

damaged-major.title: SOP-003 — Major damaged item
steps: Send A2. Ask: What damaged? Entire or part? Box also damaged?
Box AND product damaged → carrier fault → claim AND offer resolution.
Product only damaged, box intact → packing issue → offer resolution.
Assess return value. Destroyed = no return.
Resend: Linnworks, ship within 1 BD, send B7.
⚠ Kitchen/Luggage/Electronics → flag to supervisor. 3–5× refund rates.
damaged-major.escalate: High-value item or resolution beyond your authority.

damaged-minor.title: SOP-004 — Minor damaged item
steps: Send A2 to confirm damage extent.
Minor cosmetic: offer 10% discount first.
Higher discount requested: consult supervisor — do not commit.
Return insisted: issue return label, full refund.
Set damaged: offer to resend that piece only.
Open carrier claim if outer box also damaged.
damaged-minor.escalate: Customer requests above 10% — supervisor approval first.

wrong-item.title: SOP-006 — Wrong item sent
steps: Ask: "What did you receive?" Confirm exactly.
Seller error confirmed. Investigate: wrong pick or Linnworks SKU error? Notify supervisor.
⚠ FBA: Do NOT direct to Amazon. Escalate BEFORE acting.
Offer resend or full refund per preference.
Resend: Linnworks, ship within 1 BD, send B7.
Return: prepaid label — MSHZ pays all costs.
wrong-item.escalate: FBA wrong item — escalate IMMEDIATELY before contacting customer.

not-received-before.title: SOP-008 — In transit, before delivery date
steps: Check tracking — confirm in transit and on track.
Send B2 with tracking and expected delivery date.
If delivered already: switch to SOP-009.
not-received-before.escalate: No tracking movement 7+ days — open carrier investigation.

not-received-after.title: SOP-009 — Delivered, not received
steps: Confirm 4 points: address correct? household received? post office holding? neighbor received?
Send B3 — notify delivery confirmation, ask 4 points.
Open carrier search SAME DAY — do not wait.
Notify: "Investigating — allow 2 business days."
After 2 BD: located → new ETA. Not located → resend or refund.
not-received-after.escalate: High-value item — supervisor approval before resend or refund.

delayed.title: SOP-011 — Delayed parcel
steps: Assure customer: delay is with carrier, not MSHZ.
Open carrier investigation: UPS 1-800-742-5877 / USPS online / Canada Post 1-866-607-6301.
Send B3-2. "Follow up within 2 business days."
Expedited paid + past date: offer shipping refund.
Located → new ETA. Not located → resend or refund.
delayed.escalate: Carrier cannot locate after 5 BD — escalate.

listing.title: SOP-016 ★ — Listing inaccuracy
steps: Resolve customer issue first.
Do NOT close without completing Step 3.
Submit listing report to listings team: marketplace+ASIN, customer quote, what listing shows, order ID.
Add internal eDesk note: "Listing report submitted [date]."
Close ONLY after report submitted.
listing.escalate: Listings team does not action within 48h — escalate.

technical.title: SOP-015 — Technical/compatibility
steps: Ask for: (a) exact item, (b) vehicle year/make/model or device model number.
Check listing page for compatible models.
No info or unsure: use T2 (model known) or T4 (unknown).
⚠ ALL wire harness: use D3, assign to Harleen. Never guess.
technical.escalate: Always assign wire harness to Harleen — never independently.

discount.title: SOP-014 — WELCOME15 discount
steps: Determine why not received: wrong email, not subscribed, or spam.
Wrong email: confirm, provide WELCOME15 manually.
Not subscribed: ask to subscribe or offer to do it with consent.
Spam: ask to check. Not found: provide code.
Order not placed: provide WELCOME15 directly.
Order placed + confirmed subscriber: 15% partial refund.

address-not-shipped.title: SOP-012 — Address change, not shipped
steps: Park order in Linnworks immediately.
MINOR (unit, spelling, PO Box): can accommodate.
MAJOR (postal code, house number, street): cannot change. Offer cancellation.
Amazon: policy prevents changes. Offer cancellation.
⚠ CRITICAL: No changes on flagged/fraudulent Shopify orders.
address-not-shipped.escalate: Fraudulent Shopify order — escalate immediately, do not ship.

address-shipped.title: SOP-013 — Address change, already shipped
steps: Notify: address changes not possible after dispatch.
Customer contacts carrier directly with tracking number to request redirect.
Use B11-B.
